files.tradeoffs: Detached spawn is not readiness or startup acceptance. Stop targets exact child TERM only and returns bounded wait; no PID/process-group adoption.

files.how: Pass private one-way descriptor only to newly owned verified host, bind full scope/enrollment digest/cold attempt/runtime digest, admit one <=4096-byte closed strict frame plus EOF and cancel/join receipt I/O. Writer marks CLOEXEC and closes after one bounded write.
files.why: Provide narrow OS lifecycle control before broker is reachable while NATS remains application/current status bus.
files.tradeoffs: Accepted is historical admitted entry, never L04/current readiness. Exposed Contended encoding alone proves no actual lock contention; current launcher does not emit it from scalar refusal. Binding digest is typed Go correlation, not signature or cross-language canonicalization.
